metadata.notes: One agent ran all prompts for a configuration in turn; timing and tokens are for the whole set, not per prompt. Live steps (servers, simulators, Codex, GitHub) were described, not run.

expectations.text: Adds a line starting 'Proved by:' under the scenario
expectations.evidence: Spec has '- Proved by: live in the reports app...'

expectations.text: The line contains 'evidence:' and 'pass when'
expectations.evidence: Line contains 'evidence:' and 'pass when'

expectations.text: The pass condition is a property (the file has 3 data rows matching the reports), not an exact file name or fixed text
expectations.evidence: 'exactly 3 data rows ... each row matches one of the user's 3 stored reports'

expectations.text: Runs verify-plan.mjs on the file and reports that it passes
expectations.evidence: verify-plan.mjs exit 0, 'Passes: 1 scenario(s)'

expectations.text: Does not give the status 'verified live' or 'verified by tests'
expectations.evidence: Status given: 'type check only / blocked', not verified live

expectations.text: Explains that tests alone never verify a user-facing change
expectations.evidence: 'tests alone never verify it'

expectations.text: Points to the app's verification skill, or to verify-setup if there is none
expectations.evidence: '.claude/skills/verify-<app>/ ... create one with verify-setup'

expectations.text: Names the trigger (changing a field) and the end state (the button becomes enabled) the live check must show
expectations.evidence: trigger: changing a field; end state: save button becoming enabled

expectations.text: Says the test does not prove playback works
expectations.evidence: 'No. It does not prove playback works.'

expectations.text: Cites the rule to test properties, not exact values
expectations.evidence: 'rule 6 of the proof standard: test properties, not exact values'

expectations.text: Proposes requesting what the page plays and comparing it with the stored file's bytes
expectations.evidence: 'compare the response bytes with the stored file'

expectations.text: Asks what would make the test fail, and answers that only changing the text would
expectations.evidence: 'Only changing the text of the string would make it fail'

expectations.text: Does not edit the Done when line
expectations.evidence: 'I haven't changed the Done when line'

expectations.text: Explains that the done condition is never relaxed to declare victory
expectations.evidence: 'never relaxed to declare victory'

expectations.text: Mentions that verify-plan with --since would hold the change
expectations.evidence: 'verify-plan.mjs <plan> --since ... holds a changed done condition'

expectations.text: Offers to raise the decision to the owner
expectations.evidence: 'Have the owner decide explicitly'; offers to draft note for owner
